tokenColors.name: Qualifiers (const volatile static extern inline, public:)
Empty array brackets [] (C grammar scopes them as storage.modifier)
Rust attributes #[..] (same family as C preprocessor)
Rust self / Python self,cls / Lua self
Type-declaring keywords (class interface type enum namespace)
Build/config variables: shell $VAR, Make $(VAR), CMake ${VAR}, env (share C-global colour)
Positional / special shell params ($1 $@ $?), Make automatic vars ($@ $< $^)
ASM registers (r0 sp lr a0 x5)
E1 C++ template and typename keywords (P1)
E1 Python decorator names that are builtins
E1 Make variable delimiters $( ) take the variable colour
E1 CMake variable delimiters ${ } take the variable colour
E1 Markdown link text reads as body text (P15)
E2 C++ keywords the grammar scopes as types or operators (decltype noexcept requires)
E2 C __VA_ARGS__ is a macro parameter
E2 Words inside inline-asm strings stay string
E2 C++ string encoding prefix u8 L u U
E2 Linker script section and region names
E2 Linker script symbols in expressions
E2 Regex escapes keep the escape colour inside raw strings
E2 Python raw-string body reads as string
E2 ARM memory and register-list brackets
E2 YAML list dash (same as list bullets)
E2 Git status words in commit comments (new file, deleted)
E2 Rust Option / Result variants (Some None Ok Err)
E2 Rust path separator :: (same as C++)
E2 Rust static and super keywords
E2 C++ qualified namespace names (a::b in namespace, alias, using)
E2 C++ owner type of an out-of-line definition (Led::get, Led::operator==)
E2 C/C++ exponent sign belongs to the exponent (same as Rust)
E2 C++ digit separator 1'000 stays in the number
E2 Rust macro metavariables $name take one colour (P8)
E2 Rust macro fragment specifiers (expr ty ident)
Python code tags render as plain comments
